title: The Locked Library
intro: You wake up on the cold floor of an old library. Dust hangs in the lamplight. The heavy oak door is sealed with a four-digit keypad, and nobody is coming to help you. Look around, examine things, collect items and think your way out.
instructions: Type what you want to do in plain English, e.g. *examine the desk* or *use the key on the painting*.
You can *take* items, check your *inventory*, enter *codes* and ask for a *hint*.
Only things that really exist in the room can be used. Claims or demands do not change the room, only actions do.
Use the **Restart** button in the sidebar to start over.

desk.name: writing desk
desk.examine: A worn oak desk. Under the blotter you find a note in elegant handwriting: 'Order matters on the shelf. What the painter hides needs something small and brass.'

bookshelf.name: bookshelf
bookshelf.examine: A tall bookshelf full of leather spines. Four red books stand out, shelved a little crooked, as if they were pulled out and put back many times.

books.name: four red books
books.examine: You open the red books from left to right. Inside each cover is a handwritten number: 2, 7, 1 and 8.

painting.name: painting
painting.examine: A portrait of a stern librarian. The bottom of the frame has a tiny keyhole, and the painting seems to be hinged to the wall.
painting.examine_unlocked: The painting hangs open like a small door. Behind it is a wall compartment, holding a folded note.

drawer.name: drawer
drawer.examine: A small drawer in the desk, secured by a four-dial brass combination lock.
drawer.examine_unlocked: The drawer stands open. Inside are a small brass key and a torn card.

door.name: exit door
door.examine: A heavy oak door with a four-digit keypad. The display blinks red.
door.examine_unlocked: The keypad glows green and the door stands open to the night air.

brass_key.name: brass key
brass_key.examine: A small brass key. Its bow is shaped like a picture frame.
brass_key.take_text: You pick up the small brass key.

torn_card.name: torn card
torn_card.examine: A torn card with part of a number written on it: '4 7 _ _'. The rest has been ripped away.
torn_card.take_text: You pick up the torn card.

hidden_note.name: folded note
hidden_note.examine: The folded note reads: 'The last two digits are 0 and 3.'
hidden_note.take_text: You pick up the folded note.

drawer_lock.locked_text: The drawer is locked. Its four-dial brass lock needs a code.
drawer_lock.wrong_text: The dials click, but the lock stays shut. That is not the right code.
drawer_lock.unlock_text: The dials click into place and the drawer slides open. Inside are a small brass key and a torn card.

painting_lock.locked_text: The painting is stuck fast to the wall. There is a tiny keyhole in the frame.
painting_lock.wrong_text: That does not fit the keyhole. Nothing happens.
painting_lock.unlock_text: The brass key turns with a soft click. The painting swings open like a door, revealing a hidden compartment with a folded note inside.

door_lock.locked_text: The door is locked. The keypad waits for a four-digit code.
door_lock.wrong_text: The keypad buzzes and flashes red. Wrong code.
door_lock.unlock_text: The keypad turns green, the bolt slides back and the door swings open. You step out into the cool night air. You have escaped!

clues.desk_note: Desk note: 'Order matters on the shelf. What the painter hides needs something small and brass.'
clues.books_seen: Four red books on the shelf are crooked and stand out.
clues.books_digits: Numbers inside the red books, left to right: 2, 7, 1, 8.
clues.card_clue: Torn card: the exit code begins with 4 7.
clues.note_clue: Folded note: the exit code ends with 0 3.

hints.text: Hint: examine the bookshelf. Something there looks out of place.
Hint: take a closer look at the books that stick out.
Hint: you have four numbers, and the drawer has a four-dial lock.
Hint: there is something small and brass in the open drawer. Take it.
Hint: a tiny keyhole needs a tiny key. Try using the key on the painting.
Hint: examine the torn card from the drawer.
Hint: examine the folded note from behind the painting.
Hint: you hold two halves of the exit code. Put them together and enter them at the door.
